subject: Response to the Heroin Epidemic
overview: The Council heard extensive and emotional testimony from residents regarding the heroin crisis in Medford, voting to acknowledge a public health epidemic and refer the matter to a Committee of the Whole. Other business included requests to change citywide parking fees and reviews of taxi licensing and environmental mandates.

items.title: Chevalier Theatre 75th Anniversary
items.summary: Representatives from the committee for the 75th anniversary of Chevalier Theatre presented details regarding an upcoming concert and the theater's history.

items.title: Associazione Amici Common Victualler License
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for a non-profit social and cultural club located at 21 Reardon Road.

items.title: Heroin Epidemic and Addiction Advocacy
items.summary: The Council voted to acknowledge a public health epidemic after hearing testimony from families affected by addiction and police regarding local heroin overdoses. The matter was referred to a Committee of the Whole to discuss funding for resources and educational programs like the D.A.R.E. program.

items.title: Commendations
items.summary: Honored Assistant Coach John McGonigal as Assistant Coach of the Year and Lonnie Hilson Sr. for community service.

items.title: Taxi Operator License - Alvarado Castro
items.summary: Approved a taxi operator license for Marvin G. Alvarado Castro.

items.title: Taxi Operator License - Mamadou Balde
items.summary: Approved a taxi operator license for Mamadou Balde with the stipulation that outstanding moving and parking violations be paid before the license is issued.

items.title: Citywide Parking Policy and Fee Requests
items.summary: Requested that the Traffic Commission implement 15-to-30-minute free parking citywide and investigated concerns regarding convenience fees, signage, and senior center training.

items.title: Riverside Towers Heat Complaints
items.summary: Placed on file a report regarding cold hallways at 99 Riverside Avenue after management indicated they were working to rectify heating system and door cycle issues.

items.title: MS4 Stormwater Sewer Permit Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution opposing unfunded federal EPA stormwater mandates to the City Engineer for a report on financial impacts and compliance.

items.title: Andrew Sano Commendation
items.summary: Voted to congratulate local realtor Andrew Sano for being named the 2014 Massachusetts Realtor of the Year.

items.title: Promotion of State Representative Paul Donato
items.summary: Congratulated State Representative Paul J. Donato on his promotion to Second Assistant Majority Leader.

items.title: Taxi Ordinance Compliance Audit
items.summary: Referred a request to audit all taxi owners and companies for compliance with the Vehicle for Hire Ordinance to the Subcommittee on Licensing.

items.title: Group Insurance Commission (GIC) Discussion
items.summary: Discussed impending rate increases and structural changes to the state health insurance program that will affect city employees and retirees.
